Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.persistence.repository.paymentrequest

Interface KfePaymentRequestRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<KfePaymentRequestEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<KfePaymentRequestEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<KfePaymentRequestEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<KfePaymentRequestEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<KfePaymentRequestEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<KfePaymentRequestEntity>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<KfePaymentRequestEntity,UUID>
@Repository public interface KfePaymentRequestRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<KfePaymentRequestEntity,UUID>
Loads and locks payment requests by owner, public locator, settlement, and lifecycle state.

User-scoped queries preserve ownership boundaries; pessimistic variants serialize operations that consume, hide, or cancel a request. Address lookups support matching on-chain receipts to open requests, while invoice hash/string lookups support Lightning settlement observation.

    • findOpenByAddressAndRail

      @Query("select p from KfePaymentRequestEntity p\nwhere p.status = :status\n and p.rail = :rail\n and lower(p.address) = lower(:address)\norder by p.createdAt asc\n") List<KfePaymentRequestEntity> findOpenByAddressAndRail(@Param("address") String address, @Param("status") KfePaymentRequestStatus status, @Param("rail") KfeRail rail)
      Finds requests matching an address and rail without locking them.

      Address comparison is case-insensitive and results are oldest first. Use the locking variant when a matching request will be consumed or transitioned.

      Parameters:
      address - observed receiving address
      status - request state to match, typically OPEN
      rail - receiving rail associated with the observed payment
      Returns:
      requests matching the address, state, and rail

    • findOpenByAddressAndRailForUpdate

      @Lock(PESSIMISTIC_WRITE) @Query("select p from KfePaymentRequestEntity p\nwhere p.status = :status\n and p.rail = :rail\n and p.userId = :userId\n and lower(p.address) = lower(:address)\norder by p.id\n") List<KfePaymentRequestEntity> findOpenByAddressAndRailForUpdate(@Param("address") String address, @Param("status") KfePaymentRequestStatus status, @Param("rail") KfeRail rail, @Param("userId") Long userId)
      Finds and locks requests matching an address, state, rail, and owner.

      Ordering by UUID provides deterministic lock acquisition when more than one row matches.

      Parameters:
      address - observed receiving address, matched case-insensitively
      status - lifecycle state to match
      rail - receiving rail
      userId - owner whose matching request rows may be updated
      Returns:
      matching locked requests in UUID order
